dsp GenKick45s4SoftTight where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.35 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state ce : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(1.0 / (0.025 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    let ceA := select(trigger, gate * 0.2, ce * expneg(1.0 / (0.003 * sr)))
    set ce := ceA
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, 45.0 * (0.7 + colour * 0.6) * (1.0 + peA * 4.0) / sr))
    let lpA := lp + 0.5 * (nz - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(ph * 2.0) * envA + lpA * ceA) * 1.2) * 0.5023

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.35 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state ce : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(1.0 / (0.025 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    let ceA := select(trigger, gate * 0.5, ce * expneg(1.0 / (0.003 * sr)))
    set ce := ceA
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, 50.0 * (0.7 + colour * 0.6) * (1.0 + peA * 6.0) / sr))
    let lpA := lp + 0.5 * (nz - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(ph * 2.0) * envA + lpA * ceA) * 1.2) * 0.5008

dsp GenKick60s8PunchyTight where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.35 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state ce : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(1.0 / (0.025 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    let ceA := select(trigger, gate * 0.5, ce * expneg(1.0 / (0.003 * sr)))
    set ce := ceA
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, 60.0 * (0.7 + colour * 0.6) * (1.0 + peA * 8.0) / sr))
    let lpA := lp + 0.5 * (nz - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(ph * 2.0) * envA + lpA * ceA) * 1.2) * 0.5021

dsp GenKick40s10PunchyTight where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.35 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state ce : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(1.0 / (0.025 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    let ceA := select(trigger, gate * 0.5, ce * expneg(1.0 / (0.003 * sr)))
    set ce := ceA
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, 40.0 * (0.7 + colour * 0.6) * (1.0 + peA * 10.0) / sr))
    let lpA := lp + 0.5 * (nz - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(ph * 2.0) * envA + lpA * ceA) * 1.2) * 0.4949

dsp GenKick70s3SoftTight where

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.35 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state ce : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(1.0 / (0.025 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    let ceA := select(trigger, gate * 0.2, ce * expneg(1.0 / (0.003 * sr)))
    set ce := ceA
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, 70.0 * (0.7 + colour * 0.6) * (1.0 + peA * 3.0) / sr))
    let lpA := lp + 0.5 * (nz - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(ph * 2.0) * envA + lpA * ceA) * 1.2) * 0.5049

dsp GenSnare150DryPlain where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.18 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ne : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1n : F32 := 0.0
  state i2n : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.6 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let neA := select(trigger, gate, ne * expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    set ne := neA
    set p1 := fract(p1 + 150.0 / sr)
    set p2 := fract(p2 + 220.5 / sr)
    let gn := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (2500.0 + colour * 3000.0)) / sr))
    let kn := 0.8
    let an := 1.0 / (1.0 + gn * (gn + kn))
    let v1n := an * (i1n + gn * (nz - i2n))
    let v2n := i2n + gn * v1n
    set i1n := 2.0 * v1n - i1n
    set i2n := 2.0 * v2n - i2n
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((sinpi(p1 * 2.0) + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * 0.5) * envA * 0.5 + (nz - 0.8 * v1n - v2n) * neA * 0.6) * 1.0) * 0.5054

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.25 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ne : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1n : F32 := 0.0
  state i2n : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.6 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let neA := select(trigger, gate, ne * expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    set ne := neA
    set p1 := fract(p1 + 150.0 / sr)
    set p2 := fract(p2 + 220.5 / sr)
    let gn := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (4500.0 + colour * 3000.0)) / sr))
    let kn := 0.8
    let an := 1.0 / (1.0 + gn * (gn + kn))
    let v1n := an * (i1n + gn * (nz - i2n))
    let v2n := i2n + gn * v1n
    set i1n := 2.0 * v1n - i1n
    set i2n := 2.0 * v2n - i2n
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((sinpi(p1 * 2.0) + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * 0.5) * envA * 0.8 + (nz - 0.8 * v1n - v2n) * neA * 0.6) * 1.0) * 0.4886

dsp GenSnare150LoosePlain where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ne : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1n : F32 := 0.0
  state i2n : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.6 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let neA := select(trigger, gate, ne * expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    set ne := neA
    set p1 := fract(p1 + 150.0 / sr)
    set p2 := fract(p2 + 220.5 / sr)
    let gn := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (1800.0 + colour * 3000.0)) / sr))
    let kn := 0.8
    let an := 1.0 / (1.0 + gn * (gn + kn))
    let v1n := an * (i1n + gn * (nz - i2n))
    let v2n := i2n + gn * v1n
    set i1n := 2.0 * v1n - i1n
    set i2n := 2.0 * v2n - i2n
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((sinpi(p1 * 2.0) + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * 0.5) * envA * 0.5 + (nz - 0.8 * v1n - v2n) * neA * 0.6) * 1.0) * 0.5129

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.18 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ne : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1n : F32 := 0.0
  state i2n : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.6 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let neA := select(trigger, gate, ne * expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    set ne := neA
    set p1 := fract(p1 + 190.0 / sr)
    set p2 := fract(p2 + 279.3 / sr)
    let gn := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (2500.0 + colour * 3000.0)) / sr))
    let kn := 0.8
    let an := 1.0 / (1.0 + gn * (gn + kn))
    let v1n := an * (i1n + gn * (nz - i2n))
    let v2n := i2n + gn * v1n
    set i1n := 2.0 * v1n - i1n
    set i2n := 2.0 * v2n - i2n
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((sinpi(p1 * 2.0) + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * 0.5) * envA * 0.8 + (nz - 0.8 * v1n - v2n) * neA * 0.6) * 1.0) * 0.4969

dsp GenSnare190LooseRim where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ne : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1n : F32 := 0.0
  state i2n : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.6 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let neA := select(trigger, gate, ne * expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    set ne := neA
    set p1 := fract(p1 + 190.0 / sr)
    set p2 := fract(p2 + 279.3 / sr)
    let gn := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (1800.0 + colour * 3000.0)) / sr))
    let kn := 0.8
    let an := 1.0 / (1.0 + gn * (gn + kn))
    let v1n := an * (i1n + gn * (nz - i2n))
    let v2n := i2n + gn * v1n
    set i1n := 2.0 * v1n - i1n
    set i2n := 2.0 * v2n - i2n
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((sinpi(p1 * 2.0) + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * 0.5) * envA * 0.8 + (nz - 0.8 * v1n - v2n) * neA * 0.6) * 1.0) * 0.5014

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.25 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ne : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1n : F32 := 0.0
  state i2n : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.6 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let neA := select(trigger, gate, ne * expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    set ne := neA
    set p1 := fract(p1 + 240.0 / sr)
    set p2 := fract(p2 + 352.8 / sr)
    let gn := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (4500.0 + colour * 3000.0)) / sr))
    let kn := 0.8
    let an := 1.0 / (1.0 + gn * (gn + kn))
    let v1n := an * (i1n + gn * (nz - i2n))
    let v2n := i2n + gn * v1n
    set i1n := 2.0 * v1n - i1n
    set i2n := 2.0 * v2n - i2n
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((sinpi(p1 * 2.0) + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * 0.5) * envA * 0.5 + (nz - 0.8 * v1n - v2n) * neA * 0.6) * 1.0) * 0.5428

dsp GenSnare240LooseRim where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.4 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ne : F32 := 0.0
  state p1 : F32 := 0.0
  state p2 : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1n : F32 := 0.0
  state i2n : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.6 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let neA := select(trigger, gate, ne * expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    set ne := neA
    set p1 := fract(p1 + 240.0 / sr)
    set p2 := fract(p2 + 352.8 / sr)
    let gn := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (1800.0 + colour * 3000.0)) / sr))
    let kn := 0.8
    let an := 1.0 / (1.0 + gn * (gn + kn))
    let v1n := an * (i1n + gn * (nz - i2n))
    let v2n := i2n + gn * v1n
    set i1n := 2.0 * v1n - i1n
    set i2n := 2.0 * v2n - i2n
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((sinpi(p1 * 2.0) + sinpi(p2 * 2.0) * 0.5) * envA * 0.8 + (nz - 0.8 * v1n - v2n) * neA * 0.6) * 1.0) * 0.4862

dsp GenMetalClosedHatDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.06 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state q0 : F32 := 0.0
  state q1 : F32 := 0.0
  state q2 : F32 := 0.0
  state q3 : F32 := 0.0
  state q4 : F32 := 0.0
  state q5 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1m : F32 := 0.0
  state i2m : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    set q0 := fract(q0 + 164.24 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    set q1 := fract(q1 + 243.52 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    set q2 := fract(q2 + 295.68 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    set q3 := fract(q3 + 418.16 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    set q4 := fract(q4 + 432.0 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    set q5 := fract(q5 + 640.0 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    let src := (select(lt(q0, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0)) + select(lt(q1, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0)) + select(lt(q2, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0)) + select(lt(q3, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0)) + select(lt(q4, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0)) + select(lt(q5, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))) * 0.166667
    let gm := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (7000.0 + colour * 3000.0)) / sr))
    let km := 1.0
    let am := 1.0 / (1.0 + gm * (gm + km))
    let v1m := am * (i1m + gm * (src - i2m))
    let v2m := i2m + gm * v1m
    set i1m := 2.0 * v1m - i1m
    set i2m := 2.0 * v2m - i2m
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((src - v1m - v2m) * envA) * 0.8) * 3.0000

dsp GenMetalClosedHatBright where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.06 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state q0 : F32 := 0.0
  state q1 : F32 := 0.0
  state q2 : F32 := 0.0
  state q3 : F32 := 0.0
  state q4 : F32 := 0.0
  state q5 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1m : F32 := 0.0
  state i2m : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    set q0 := fract(q0 + 246.36 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    set q1 := fract(q1 + 365.28 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    set q2 := fract(q2 + 443.52 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    set q3 := fract(q3 + 627.24 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    set q4 := fract(q4 + 648.0 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    set q5 := fract(q5 + 960.0 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    let src := (select(lt(q0, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0)) + select(lt(q1, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0)) + select(lt(q2, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0)) + select(lt(q3, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0)) + select(lt(q4, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0)) + select(lt(q5, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))) * 0.166667
    let gm := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (7000.0 + colour * 3000.0)) / sr))
    let km := 1.0
    let am := 1.0 / (1.0 + gm * (gm + km))
    let v1m := am * (i1m + gm * (src - i2m))
    let v2m := i2m + gm * v1m
    set i1m := 2.0 * v1m - i1m
    set i2m := 2.0 * v2m - i2m
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((src - v1m - v2m) * envA) * 0.8) * 3.0000

metalClosedHatTrashy.source:
dsp GenMetalClosedHatTrashy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.06 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state q0 : F32 := 0.0
  state q1 : F32 := 0.0
  state q2 : F32 := 0.0
  state q3 : F32 := 0.0
  state q4 : F32 := 0.0
  state q5 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1m : F32 := 0.0
  state i2m : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    set q0 := fract(q0 + 307.95 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    set q1 := fract(q1 + 456.6 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    set q2 := fract(q2 + 554.4 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    set q3 := fract(q3 + 784.05 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    set q4 := fract(q4 + 810.0 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    set q5 := fract(q5 + 1200.0 * (0.8 + colour * 0.4) / sr)
    let src := (select(lt(q0, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0)) + select(lt(q1, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0)) + select(lt(q2, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0)) + select(lt(q3, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0)) + select(lt(q4, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0)) + select(lt(q5, 0.5), 1.0, (0.0 - 1.0))) * 0.166667 + nz * 0.4
    let gm := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (7000.0 + colour * 3000.0)) / sr))
    let km := 1.0
    let am := 1.0 / (1.0 + gm * (gm + km))
    let v1m := am * (i1m + gm * (src - i2m))
    let v2m := i2m + gm * v1m
    set i1m := 2.0 * v1m - i1m
    set i2m := 2.0 * v2m - i2m
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((src - v1m - v2m) * envA) * 0.8) * 1.0928
